GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, same turn, Straightened Up 3l off, kept on one pace # no run on
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3 Wide 4th 3 Lengths 800m 4th 5 Lengths home turn Hooked Out 3 Wide 4th 3 Lengths Middle Of Track Straight tired final 100m # every ch/weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was reminded of his obligation to ride his mount out fully to the finishing line.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back near last 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted out and made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out sat back 7l off, wsung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, battled on ok # fitter/further
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, momentarily unbalancing its rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok landed box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little and dropped out # weak run home
Jumped Well rolled forward to face breeze 1 length off, much the same turn, Straightened Up half off, joined in 100m, took over 50m and drew clear late # breeze/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped. Rdr reported as per previous starts, the intention has been to settle in a more forward position, however the gelding has been slow to begin and settled back. He said after beginning well from a wide barrier today he was able to obtain a prominent position outside the lead.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length settled last 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off held up, clear 100m and hit line well # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Momentarily had difficulty obtaining clear running  approaching the 200m, before improving into a narrow run between rnrs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back 5-6l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after losing its near-hind plate en route to the barriers and was unable to be re-plated and was approved to race bare foot behind, and was passed fit to start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped Just Ok . went back last early then 4th Inside Just 3 Lengths @ 800m. off fence Clear enough Straightening Up but run peaked 200m and was plain to line # run peaked 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to have a poor post-race recovery and to be suffering from heat stress. Trainer was advised a vet clearance would be required prior to next race/trial.
Shortly after the start, was bumped by another runner, which shifted in. Travelled keenly during the middle stages.
